comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Makes motors, drives and controls for motion control; no pumps, valves or friction products, so the business differs.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mainly electronic instruments and sensors; its electromechanical segment is small and doesn't cover pumps, valves or braking.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Engineered valves, pumps, connectors and aerospace components sold to OEMs and process industries, with aftermarket. Closely mirrors ITT's mix.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Mainly an MRO distributor and service provider, not a manufacturer of engineered components.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Welding and cutting equipment and consumables; a different product and customer base from pumps, valves and motion components.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Diversified aerospace/naval filtration, utility test and RF shielding; only loosely related fluid-control overlap.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Engineered pumps, valves and seals for process industries with a large aftermarket; matches ITT's Industrial Process business.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Custom electrical switchgear and power control rooms, a project-based electrical equipment business, not flow or motion components.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Industrial hardware, locks and castings; different products from engineered pumps, brakes and connectors despite some OEM overlap.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Manufactures industrial and municipal pumps sold via distributors; overlaps ITT's pump business, though narrower.
